about: Worked examples of a bin's count (protocol/count.go, shared/count.js). Read by TestCountExamples (Go), shared/testdata/js/count.test.js (JS), and the tests of the two SQL copies: the Edge claim read (capacity.PiecesPerCycleSQL) and Core's inventory list. Owner's rule, 2026-11-19: a bin counts what is in the carrier, parts for one line and kits for several; UOP = count / ratio, whole part, the parts left over beside it.

examples.name: a full pack, 800 parts at 8 a cycle
803 parts at 8, typed above the pack
3 parts left and a cycle of 8 drawn: -5

a kit cart of 60: 60 A, 60 B, 120 C
ratio 1: the count is the UOP
a line that says 0 a cycle is 1
